name: TasmaNet
summary: Tasmanian wireless/data carrier, founded 2004; acquired by Field Solutions Group (Dec 2021), then by Comms Group from FSG's receivers (May 2025) (A.C.N. 111 240 978 PTY LTD (Trading name Tasmanet Pty Ltd), ACN 111 240 978).

events.details: TasmaNet acquired by Field Solutions Group (announced 29 Oct 2021, ~$13M).
TasmaNet business acquired by Comms Group from Field Solutions' receivers after FSG entered administration 19 Feb 2025.
